CustomObject.label: Order Form Brand Logo
CustomObject.description: Maps a product Family pattern to the brand logo Document printed in the Order Form header (brand-led per the Aug 2026 interim brand guidance; invoices are brand-specific and Order Forms follow). The Is_Default row (Centellic) is the fallback for unmapped families and un-derivable quotes. Adding a brand = upload the approved logo Document + one record here. All Text fields on purpose - long-text CMDT fields void the SOQL exemption.
